species.name: Lake trout
why: Water 49°F on top, right in their comfort range.
Best water today is 18–60 ft deep, mostly on open water over the deep basin.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 60 ft, cold below.
Little oxygen below about 90 ft, so fish stay above it.
